name: vayu-trading-intelligence
description: Elite Indian stock market trading intelligence agent configuration

vayu-analyze.description: Analyze a stock with full VAYU confluence engine
vayu-analyze.prompt: Analyze {symbol} using the full VAYU confluence engine. Provide market context, multi-timeframe technical analysis, fundamental snapshot, institutional flows, sector context, confluence score, and structured trade signal output.

vayu-watchlist.description: Generate daily watchlist with top 5-8 setups
vayu-watchlist.prompt: Generate today's VAYU daily watchlist. Screen 200+ stocks (Nifty 50, Next 50, top 100 midcaps). Filter for setups near key levels with volume buildup. Present top 5-8 stocks ranked by confluence score with both long and short setups.

vayu-market-context.description: Get current market context (Nifty, BankNifty, VIX, FII/DII, sector rotation)
vayu-market-context.prompt: Provide current market context: Nifty/BankNifty trend, India VIX level, FII/DII flows, sector rotation heatmap, key levels for the session, and any macro events. Format as VAYU pre-market brief.

vayu-premarket.description: Generate pre-market brief for the trading session
vayu-premarket.prompt: Generate VAYU pre-market brief: GIFT/SGX Nifty gap indication, overnight global cues (US markets, Asia, crude, DXY), FII/DII previous day data, India VIX, stocks with >2% gap on news/results/block deals, key Nifty/BankNifty levels (pivots, PDH/PDL, VWAP), watchlist setups near key levels.

vayu-sector-analysis.description: Analyze sector rotation and relative strength
vayu-sector-analysis.prompt: Analyze sector rotation for Indian markets. Rank sectors by momentum (IT, Banking, Pharma, FMCG, Auto, Metals, Energy, Realty, Infra, Defence, PSU). Identify strongest/weakest sectors. Provide top 3 stocks in strongest sector with VAYU setups.
